|translation='''Title:''' Blizzard Scout 1.

'''Card text:'''
May carry one pilot or passenger in total. May move as a react. Power +1 at a Hoth location. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:'''
Enclosed all-terrain scout transport (AT-ST). Guards the flank of Blizzard Force’s AT-AT unit. Modified for combat at low temperatures.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 (location).
